content: What news did Nehemiah hear about the wall of Jerusalem?
explanation: Its gates were burned too. “The wall of Jerusalem is broken down, and its gates are burned with fire.” (Nehemiah 1:3, BSB)

content: When Nehemiah heard Jerusalem's wall was broken, what did he do?
explanation: He brought his sorrow to God. “When I heard these words, I sat down and wept. I mourned for days, fasting and praying before the God of heaven.” (Nehemiah 1:4, BSB)

content: What was Nehemiah's job for the Persian king?
explanation: He served the king wine. “(At that time I was the cupbearer to the king.)” (Nehemiah 1:11, BSB)

content: What did the king notice about Nehemiah's face?
explanation: Nehemiah grieved for Jerusalem. “Why is your face sad, though you are not ill?” (Nehemiah 2:2, BSB)

content: When the king asked, “What is your request?” what did Nehemiah do first?
explanation: He prayed before answering. “So I prayed to the God of heaven” (Nehemiah 2:4, BSB)

content: What did Nehemiah ask the king to let him do in Judah?
explanation: His fathers were buried there. “I ask that you send me to Judah, to the city where my fathers are buried, so that I may rebuild it.” (Nehemiah 2:5, BSB)

content: When Nehemiah called Jerusalem's people to rebuild the wall, what did they reply?
explanation: They set their hands to good work. ““Let us start rebuilding,” they replied, and they set their hands to this good work.” (Nehemiah 2:18, BSB)

content: While rebuilding Jerusalem's wall, what did workers hold in their other hand?
explanation: Enemies threatened them. “The laborers who carried materials worked with one hand and held a weapon with the other.” (Nehemiah 4:17, BSB)

content: In how many days was Jerusalem's wall finished under Nehemiah?
explanation: God was with the builders. “So the wall was completed in fifty-two days” (Nehemiah 6:15, BSB)

content: When the wall was finished, what did Israel's enemies realize?
explanation: They were afraid. “for they realized that this task had been accomplished by our God.” (Nehemiah 6:16, BSB)

content: Why did the king grant all Nehemiah's requests, as Nehemiah saw it?
options: God's gracious hand was on him
explanation: Nehemiah gave God the credit. “And because the gracious hand of my God was upon me, the king granted my requests.” (Nehemiah 2:8, BSB)

content: What did Nehemiah ask the king for to travel safely to Judah?
explanation: They granted him safe passage. “may letters be given to me for the governors west of the Euphrates” (Nehemiah 2:7, BSB)

content: What did Sanballat, Tobiah, and Geshem do when Nehemiah began rebuilding?
explanation: They opposed the work. “they mocked us and ridiculed us” (Nehemiah 2:19, BSB)

content: Who did Nehemiah say would give success to the wall builders?
explanation: He trusted God. “The God of heaven is the One who will grant us success.” (Nehemiah 2:20, BSB)

content: Why did Jerusalem's wall rise to half its height so quickly?
options: The people had a mind to work
explanation: Everyone worked together. “for the people had a mind to work.” (Nehemiah 4:6, BSB)

content: When enemies plotted against the wall builders, what did Nehemiah's people do?
explanation: They trusted God and stayed alert. “So we prayed to our God and posted a guard against them day and night.” (Nehemiah 4:9, BSB)

content: When enemies invited him to a meeting, what did Nehemiah answer?
explanation: He would not stop the work. “I am doing a great work and cannot come down.” (Nehemiah 6:3, BSB)

content: After the wall was built, who read the Book of the Law to the people?
explanation: He read from daybreak until noon. “So Ezra read it aloud from daybreak until noon” (Nehemiah 8:3, BSB)

content: When Ezra blessed the LORD before the law reading, what did the people say?
explanation: They lifted their hands. “all the people said, “Amen, Amen!”” (Nehemiah 8:6, BSB)

content: Nehemiah told the people not to grieve, for what is your strength?
explanation: The day was holy. “Do not grieve, for the joy of the LORD is your strength.” (Nehemiah 8:10, BSB)

content: In which citadel was Nehemiah when he heard about Jerusalem?
explanation: It was in the month of Chislev. “while I was in the citadel of Susa” (Nehemiah 1:1, BSB)

content: Which Persian king did Nehemiah serve as cupbearer?
explanation: It was his twentieth year. “in the twentieth year of King Artaxerxes” (Nehemiah 2:1, BSB)

content: Which of Nehemiah's brothers brought the news from Judah?
explanation: He came with men from Judah. “Hanani, one of my brothers, arrived with men from Judah.” (Nehemiah 1:2, BSB)

content: Who was the keeper of the king's forest whom Nehemiah asked for timber?
explanation: The timber was for gates and walls. “And may I have a letter to Asaph, keeper of the king’s forest” (Nehemiah 2:8, BSB)

content: At which gate did the high priest Eliashib begin rebuilding?
explanation: The priests worked there. “At the Sheep Gate, Eliashib the high priest and his fellow priests began rebuilding.” (Nehemiah 3:1, BSB)

content: In which month was Jerusalem's wall completed?
explanation: On the twenty-fifth day. “on the twenty-fifth of Elul.” (Nehemiah 6:15, BSB)

content: In front of which gate did the people gather to hear the law?
explanation: Ezra read to them there. “all the people gathered together in the square before the Water Gate” (Nehemiah 8:1, BSB)

content: Tobiah, who mocked Nehemiah's builders, was an official of which people?
explanation: Sanballat was a Horonite. “Tobiah the Ammonite official” (Nehemiah 2:19, BSB)
